home_arch_dad.text: We get a lot of visitors looking for the Spanish Arch. It is a bit of the old city wall, that is all, and very nicely carved.
Every house round here has a cluricaun story. Mine says one lives behind the boiler and mends the family shoes at night.
The shoes do not look mended. But they do go missing, so he must be doing something.

then.text: Back for the Soda Bread? Kitchen's yours.

else.text: Cut the cross in the top, so the fairies can get out. Or so my mother said.
Flour, salt, bread soda and buttermilk, mixed quick and not kneaded to death. A deep cross on top, into a hot oven. Hollow underneath when it's done.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. Use my kitchen.
